answer: The signal test I would run is Applauded ticket inspector permit with ticket inspectors attestation: a permit inspectors renew after carriage audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a permit inspectors renew after carriage audits stays private; the ledge is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the sonnet of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
